versions.changelog:
Initial release of geo-template-library: standardized, ready-to-use templates for high-citation GEO content.

- Provides a catalog of markdown templates for common GEO content types (definitions, FAQs, guides, comparison pages, etc.)
- Annotates GEO-critical fields for AI citation and consistency
- Helps cross-team standardization and rapid content creation
- Designed to integrate with other GEO skills (e.g., geo-citation-writer, geo-content-optimizer)
- Includes workflow: scenario clarification, template selection, template output, and example snippets
